coverageNotes: Tests schema construction APIs with all table fields supplied; no application modeling or implementation coverage.

questions.question: Which export builds the Convex schema?

options.rationale: Field maps are not table definitions. Schema export cannot serialize these as tables.
defineTable builds table definitions and defineSchema wraps them as the deployable schema.
An object validator describes a value, not a table definition.
A plain object of table definitions does not provide the schema export contract.
